guideUpdate.title: Navigate from API Request Audit to the Dashboards placeholder
guideUpdate.affectedSection: Launcher navigation to API Request Audit and Dashboards
steps: Open the launcher and select API Request Audit.
Use the browser Back control to return to the launcher.
View the Under construction message and select Back to Launcher when you want to return.
